# Test fixtures

Small files made during the event from fresh downloads, by `scripts/fixtures.py` (`frame/`, `sia/`),
`scripts/make_cube_fixture.py` (`cube/`) and `scripts/make_flags_fixture.py` (`flags/`). Keep each under 2 MB.
They hold SPHEREx DR1 and QR3 pixels and IRSA SIA replies, under IRSA's terms (see `DATA-LICENSES.md`).
Every file lists its source URL and run time in a sidecar `.json` or in its own header; the script for each
folder is the one named above.
